svg.title: Request lifecycle: client → gateway → service
svg.desc: Animated sequence. 1 client sends POST /api/v1/orders with a bearer token and Idempotency-Key. 2 the gateway normalises the path, assigns x-request-id and x-correlation-id and starts a server span. 3-4 it checks the Redis-backed rate limit (fail-open). 5 it proxies to order-service with a 10 second timeout and a per-upstream circuit breaker; the fetch instrumentation injects traceparent. 6-7 order-service verifies the ES256 access token against the cached JWKS of auth-service. 8-9 it snapshots prices from product-service over the internal API. 10 it commits the order, saga state and outbox row in one transaction. 11-12 the response, or an application/problem+json error, flows back with X-Request-Id.
svg.text: POST /api/v1/orders through the API gateway (apps/api-gateway) into order-service
proxy: traceparent + x-request-id · 10 s timeout · breaker
one tx: order PENDING + saga + outbox row
Animated (CSS) · loops every 14 s · Reduced motion: all steps shown · static Mermaid version: docs/architecture/02-request-lifecycle.md
